verdict: Stryker's sales rose 8% to $6.5B on strong MedSurg growth, but a $293M goodwill impairment cut reported EPS 12% to $1.96 — excluding that and similar items, adjusted EPS rose 10% to $3.52.

kpis.label: Revenue growth
kpis.note: net sales of $6,520M, +7.7% reported and organic

kpis.label: EPS (GAAP)
kpis.note: diluted, vs $2.22 a year ago; adjusted EPS was $3.52

kpis.label: MedSurg & Neurotechnology sales
kpis.note: +9% vs a year ago, 56% of total sales

kpis.label: Goodwill impairment
kpis.note: one-off charge, vs no goodwill impairment a year ago

segments.name: MedSurg and Neurotechnology
segments.note: Surgical instruments, endoscopy, medical beds and neurotechnology — sales rose 9.2%, led by Endoscopy (+14%) and Medical (+10%), with growth driven by higher unit volume.

segments.name: Orthopaedics
segments.note: Knee and hip implants, trauma products and orthopaedic technology — sales rose 5.7%, with Ortho Tech up 16% partly offset by slower implant growth.

opex.name: R&D
opex.note: Research, development and engineering — up 6% vs a year ago.

opex.name: SG&A
opex.note: Selling, general and administrative expenses — up 13% vs a year ago.

opex.name: Amortization
opex.note: Amortization of purchased intangible assets from past acquisitions.

opex.name: Goodwill & other impairments
opex.note: A $293M goodwill impairment charge — the single biggest reason reported profit fell.

takeaways.title: Volume drove sales growth
takeaways.text: Organic net sales rose 7.7%, driven by unit volume. MedSurg and Neurotechnology grew 9.2% to $3,664M while Orthopaedics grew 5.7% to $2,856M — good performance, management said, but short of its own expectations.

takeaways.title: Impairment cut reported EPS
takeaways.text: A $293M goodwill impairment (plus $153M of structural optimization and other special charges in the adjusted reconciliation) pushed reported operating margin down to 15.9% and EPS down 12% to $1.96, even as adjusted EPS rose 10% to $3.52.

takeaways.title: A billion back to shareholders
takeaways.text: Stryker repurchased $1.0B of its own stock in the quarter, and in October the board added another $3.0B to the buyback program. Full-year guidance is now 6.5–7.0% organic sales growth and adjusted EPS of $14.80–$14.90.

oneTimers: $293M goodwill impairment charge in the quarter (the reconciliation specifies the full $293M was goodwill).

Structural optimization and other special charges added a further $153M operating-income adjustment in the company's adjusted reconciliation, including $77M related to the Spinal Implants sale and $37M for terminating sales relationships in certain countries.
